description: View vital signs data from a simulated medical device in OpenICE. First, create a simulated Multiparameter Monitor device adapter (if not already present) by clicking 'Create an ICE Device Adapter', selecting 'Simulated' category and 'Multiparameter Monitor' type, then clicking 'Start'. Once the device appears in the Devices panel on the right side, click on the device icon to open the device details view. This view shows real-time vital sign waveforms (ECG, SpO2 plethysmograph) and numeric values (heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation). Observe that the vital signs data is being displayed with updating values.
